name: Rosario
source:
A failed "Child of the Goddess." A wise but cheeky boy.

There are places where he cannot be obedient because of his stubbornness.

He is the one and only person who goes beyond Lily for anything.

"My heart belongs only to me."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
